# CSSEBets

> CSSEBets is a closed community points club: stake community points on live football, Formula 1 and UFC markets, or play CSSE Originals arcade games from one wallet.

It is built for members of a private sports community (and guests on practice points) — not a public casino. Markets are priced from a global odds feed. Every stake, settlement and payout is auditable in the player's wallet history. Arcade games are server-authoritative and provably fair.

## Who it's for

- Community members who want shared sports tipping and house arcade play
- Guests trying the product with practice points before joining
- Players who want live odds and clear, auditable point settlements

- [Home](/): Guest gate into the app (practice session or member dashboard).
